title: Govind Ballabh Pant
summary: Moves the Advisory Committee on fundamental rights, minorities and tribal/excluded areas and later defends its negotiated membership structure.

title: K. M. Munshi
summary: Moves amendments expanding the committee, substituting a named membership, increasing presidential nominations, fixing report deadlines and changing vacancy procedure.

title: Jaipal Singh
summary: Challenges the adequacy and distribution of tribal representation and points to omitted communities and the absence of a tribal woman.

title: Dakshayani Velayudhan
summary: Argues that Scheduled Caste members should not be treated as speaking only for a sectional category and presses for wider representational recognition.

title: N. Gopalaswami Ayyangar
summary: Moves the one-third quorum requirement for the Advisory Committee and its sub-committees.

title: Frank Anthony
summary: Defends adequate Anglo-Indian representation and argues that smaller minorities need enough presence to influence safeguards affecting them.

title: Damber Singh Gurung
summary: Argues that Gorkhas require representation on the body charged with minority and backward-area safeguards.

title: Syamanandan Sahaya
summary: Objects to replacing proportional representation with a predetermined list and later raises a point of order about committee-election procedure.

title: K. Santhanam
summary: Warns that the Advisory Committee should not absorb work reserved for the whole Assembly and asks for early circulation of reports.

title: J. J. M. Nichols-Roy
summary: Supports sub-committee co-option as a way to handle the diversity of tribal areas and also asks consideration for additional Christian representation.

title: S. Nagappa
summary: Questions community seat distribution and asks members to protect under-represented Scheduled Caste interests.

title: B. Das
summary: Warns that uniform minority safeguards may impose disproportionate administrative and financial burdens on poorer provinces such as Orissa.

title: Dr. Rajendra Prasad
summary: Manages the amendment sequence, committee-election rulings, final adoption, budget procedure and Assembly staff autonomy.
